DATA CONNECTION

Connect market data

The hosted terminal runs backtests in your browser. Import a market-data JSON file, or run the included FastAPI server to collect data from FMP.

pip install -r requirements.txt
export FMP_API_KEY='your-api-key'
python -m uvicorn backend.app:app --port 8000

Real data 2022–25 also needs the local server: it builds data/market.sqlite once from Yahoo Finance prices and SEC EDGAR 10-K revenue (or run python -m backend.realdata beforehand), then reads it for every backtest.

Requires Python 3.10+ and Node.js 22+. Open http://localhost:8000, then select Connect FMP. Your API key stays on the server.

FMP uses the current top 200 US stocks. This introduces survivorship and look-ahead bias. Import historical universe snapshots for point-in-time screening.
